name: macos-baseline
title: macOS endpoint baseline
description: The settings every managed Mac owes its owner: encrypted disk, intact platform protections, a firewall, automatic security updates, and a locked screen. Read-only checks; inspired by the CIS macOS Benchmark and Apple Platform Security guidance, not certified CIS content.

rules.title: FileVault full-disk encryption is on
rules.rationale: A lost or stolen laptop with an unencrypted disk is a data breach; with FileVault it is a hardware loss.

rules.title: System Integrity Protection is enabled
rules.rationale: SIP stops even root from modifying system files and injecting into protected processes. Disabled SIP removes the floor every other control stands on.

rules.title: Gatekeeper is enabled
rules.rationale: Gatekeeper blocks unsigned and un-notarized software from running on first launch — the most common malware delivery path on macOS.

rules.title: application firewall is on
rules.rationale: Laptops join networks you do not control. The firewall keeps listening services from being reachable on them.

rules.title: firewall stealth mode is on
rules.rationale: Stealth mode drops probes instead of answering them, so the machine is harder to enumerate on hostile networks.

rules.title: automatic update checks are on
rules.rationale: A Mac that never checks for updates never learns a fix exists.

rules.title: updates download automatically
rules.rationale: Pre-downloaded updates shorten the window between a fix shipping and it being installed.

rules.title: security responses install automatically
rules.rationale: Rapid Security Responses and XProtect data patch actively exploited bugs; waiting for a human defeats their purpose.

rules.title: guest account is disabled
rules.rationale: The guest account gives anyone with physical access a session on the machine and its network position.

rules.title: automatic login is disabled
rules.rationale: Automatic login hands a full user session to whoever opens the lid, and stores the password recoverably on disk.

rules.title: screen locks within 5 minutes of sleep or screensaver
rules.rationale: An unlocked, unattended session bypasses every authentication control on the machine.

rules.title: /etc/sudoers is 0440
rules.rationale: A writable sudoers file is a one-line path to root.

rules.title: root is the only UID-0 account
rules.rationale: A second UID-0 account is a classic persistence mechanism.
